cases.title: Live on the Streets
cases.kicker: Animated billboards · DOOH · ITS · ITHS · FSU
cases.line: 50+ billboards across Belgrade, designed for the three seconds a driver gives them.
cases.brief: Three schools in one group, all chasing the attention of teenagers and parents in a loud city. A driver gives a billboard three seconds, and a new campaign was due almost every month.
cases.idea: Treat every billboard like the first three seconds of a reel: one message, one image, one move. Make the end frame strong enough to print, and ship every board with its social, web and email set.

lab.title: Drive *past it*
lab.line: Most people meet a billboard at speed, at night, for a few seconds. Pick a speed and a school, drive by, then see what a driver takes home.
lab.why: Design for the glance, not the desk. A message that survives 130 km/h survives a feed.

craft.title: One message, one image, *one move*
craft.text: The text never moves, so it can be read at any frame. Everything around it does: a scanner beat, a glitch on one word, a squeegee of colour. Fifteen seconds that loop clean on an LED screen.

rows.label: ITS · Nov 2026 · a scanner beat carries the type
ITHS · Nov 2026 · four glitches, calm behind

craft.title: Every board ships *as a set*
craft.text: Logo, headline, intakes and contacts recomposed for every channel the same week: feed, email, website card and strip. One idea, every size, no weak link.

craft.title: Calendars, ads and *events*
craft.text: The same motion language runs the academic calendar, vertical ads and event boards, so a chess trophy and a graduation feel like the same schools as the enrolment drive.

cases.result_label: billboards live across Belgrade in two years
cases.result: Plus animated ads and academic calendars for all three schools: one motion language across every street and screen.

cases.title: Ballies
cases.kicker: Character design · NFT collection · Brand universe
cases.line: A team of characters built to be collected, then cast in three years of launches, seasons and key art.
cases.role: Digital artist · characters, NFT art direction, campaigns, motion
cases.brief: A sports prediction app needed a face. Not one mascot, a whole roster: characters fans could own, trade and play with, strong enough to front every launch for years.
cases.idea: Draw one player, perfectly. Lock the pose, proportions and line on a single rig, and let personality live in traits: headwear, eyes, arms, balls and kits. One body, 9,999 characters.

lab.title: Mix a *Ballie*
lab.line: Every Ballie is drawn on the same rig, so any head fits any kit. Spin the reels, tap a part to swap it, lock the ones you like.
lab.why: A character system buys variety that never breaks the brand: thousands of collectible faces that still read as one team.

craft.title: One rig, a roster of *personalities*
craft.text: Pose, proportions and line weight never change, so every trait swaps cleanly and the set reads as one team. Personality lives in the details: a wink, a jester hat, a robot arm, a planet for a ball.

craft.title: The cast goes *to work*
craft.text: The characters front everything: holiday drops, tournaments, AI features, the roadmap. A cast people recognise turned a daily posting schedule into one ongoing story.

craft.title: Sport, shot like *cinema*
craft.text: For legends and match days: athletes mid-air, stadium light and one bold line of type. Built to stop the thumb in a feed full of odds.

rows.label: Edelman vs Gravity · match-day key art

cases.result: Then three years of seasons, launches and key art starring them: hundreds of assets in one recognisable universe.

cases.title: Personal Art
cases.kicker: Cinematic compositing · Key art · Personal work
cases.line: Single frames that carry a whole film: a winter battle, a duel in the rain, an empire at dawn. Mastered in 4K and 8K.
cases.brief: No client, so I set the hardest brief I could: make one frame carry an entire story, at a size where every flaw shows.
cases.idea: Direct it like a film shot. Lock the composition and one light first, then make every element obey it: the same low sun, the same haze, the same lens. Grade it as one picture.

lab.title: Look *closer*
lab.line: The Battle of Kolubara is 7680 pixels wide. Move the loupe over it, or jump to a detail, and see what holds up at full size.
lab.why: Billboards, cinema screens and prints forgive nothing. Craft is what is still there when you zoom in.
spots: Back-lit by one low sun: a rim of light on the cap, the moustache and the raised hand.
Fire-eaten silk. The burnt edge glows; the colours fade where the flame has been.
The front rank sits in shadow, so the snow catching the light reads first.
Small figures far back, half lost in the haze, give the hill its height.
Hundreds of bayonets thinning into the mist: scale told by atmosphere, not by detail.

craft.title: One sun for *every* element
craft.text: Figures, flags, smoke and sky all answer to the same light, the same haze and the same lens, so the frame reads as one photograph, never as a collage.

rows.label: Tsar Dušan, 1346 · an empire at dawn · 3840×2160

craft.title: Built like a *one-sheet*
craft.text: Fan art made the way a studio poster is: one collision of light, reflections on wet stone, rain that catches the glow. The detail survives a cinema-sized crop.

rows.label: Batman v Superman · Clash in the Rain · detail at 100%

craft.title: Type that *belongs* to the picture
craft.text: Titles set by hand in period letterforms, tracked wide, sized to whisper and placed where the eye lands last.

rows.label: The Battle of Kolubara · title at 8K

cases.result: Personal art is where everything I know meets: composition, light, type and story, in one frame.
cases.note: Characters and titles in fan art belong to their owners.

cases.title: FSU 2026
cases.kicker: Campaigns & exhibition identities · Faculty of Contemporary Arts
cases.line: An art school, art-directed: 30+ campaigns, exhibitions and events in one year.
cases.client: FSU · Faculty of Contemporary Arts, Belgrade
cases.brief: People judge an art faculty by its own posters. Every exhibition, lecture and enrolment deadline needed an identity good enough to hang in its own gallery.
cases.idea: Every show gets its own concept. The constant is the frame: FSU's typographic system, so twenty different worlds still read as one school.

lab.title: Walk *the gallery*
lab.line: So we hung them in one. Drag to walk past a year of FSU exhibitions, talks and nights, each with an identity of its own.
lab.why: Range inside one brand: every world is different, and every one is clearly FSU.

craft.title: One door, *three stories*
craft.text: FSU Doors: “Create it. Move it. What did you open?” Three posts that work alone and read as one campaign in the grid.

craft.title: One template, *thirty courses*
craft.text: Costume Design MA: a key visual and a post per course. The frame stays, the costume and the colour change, so thirty posts never feel like one post thirty times.

craft.title: From A5 flyers to *lecture halls*
craft.text: The enrolment flyer, the study-programme presentation and the social set come from one source, so the school looks the same in your hand and on the big screen.

cases.result: Across print, social, email, web and gallery walls: each one its own world, all of them clearly FSU.

cases.title: Series at Scale
cases.line: Eight series, 330+ assets, one system: careers, programmes, AI prompts, events and enrolment.
cases.client: ITS · Information Technology School · ITHS · IT High School
cases.brief: Education marketing runs on volume: dozens of programmes, careers and deadlines, each needing its own post, without the feed turning into a template graveyard.
cases.idea: Give every series one strong signature, portrait, light and type, and let the system carry the repetition, so post 33 looks as considered as post 1.

lab.title: Flip *the series*
lab.line: Thirty-three careers, one layout. Drag across the post to flip through them: the person and the title change, nothing else moves.
lab.why: A system is what lets a small team publish every day and still look art-directed.
lab.alt: What does a … do? A career series for ITS: one portrait and one title per post

cases.title: Baby Boo
cases.line: Product films and stills without a studio: honey that pours on cue, glass you break in case of a sudden voyage.
cases.client: Baby Boo · natural cosmetics, made by moms
cases.role: Concept, art direction, generation, edit, finishing
cases.brief: Premium films and stills for a small natural-cosmetics brand. No studio, no crew, no shoot day, and the jar has to look exactly like the one on the shelf.
cases.idea: Direct it like a commercial shoot: the label stays true to the real product, the honey pours on cue, the bees sit in shallow focus. Every still gets one bold idea, every film is cut and graded like a real spot.

lab.title: Pour it *yourself*
lab.line: In a product film nothing moves by accident. Drag across the jar to pour the honey, drag back to undo it.
lab.why: Clients do not buy footage, they buy control: the product exactly right, the moment exactly when the cut needs it.
lab.alt: Manuka Honey face cream: honey pours over a stack of jars

craft.title: Product-true, *frame by frame*
craft.text: Label, mascot, cap and proportions stay true to the real jar in every frame, so the stills can sell the product, not just a mood.

craft.title: One bold idea *per still*
craft.text: Break the glass in case of a sudden voyage. A claw machine full of jars. A carousel of giraffes. Each launch got one idea strong enough to post on its own.

rows.label: Break glass in case of a sudden voyage

craft.title: Cut like a *commercial*
craft.text: Vertical first, timed to the beat, graded as one spot: the pilot runs as a 9:16 for Reels and TikTok with a 4K master for the web.

cases.result: Vertical-first product films for Reels and TikTok, a 4K master for the web and a library of concept stills for every launch.
